Its products and services include credit cards, business credit cards, corporate programs, gift cards, savings accounts and CDs, and the American Express App. It operates through the following segments: the United States Consumer Services (USCS), Commercial Services (CS), International Card Services (ICS), Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS), and Corporate and Other. The USCS segment includes proprietary consumer cards and provides services to United States consumers. The CS segment offers corporate and small business cards and provides services to United States businesses. The ICS segment provides consumers, small businesses, and corporate cards outside the United States. The GMNS segment is involved in operating a global payments network that processes and settles card transactions, acquires merchants, and provides multi-channel marketing programs and capabilities, services and data analytics. The Corporate and Other segment covers corporate functions and certain other businesses and operations. It also operates through the following geographical segments: United States, EMEA, APAC, LACC, and Other. The EMEA segment represents Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The APAC segment refers to Asia Pacific, Australia, and New Zealand. The LACC segment focuses on Latin America, Canada, and the Caribbean. The Other segment includes net costs which are not directly allocated to specific geographic regions. The company was founded by Henry Wells, William G. Fargo, and John Warren Butterfield on March 28, 1850 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 美國運通公司從事發卡、商家收單和卡片網路業務。其產品和服務包括信用卡、商業信用卡、企業計劃、禮品卡、儲蓄帳戶和 CD 以及美國運通應用程式。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國消費者服務部門 (USCS)、商業服務部門 (CS)、國際卡服務部門 (ICS)、全球商家和網路服務部門 (GMNS) 以及企業及其他部門。 USCS 部門包括專有消費者卡並向美國消費者提供服務。 CS 部門提供公司和小型商務卡，並為美國企業提供服務。 ICS 部門為美國境外的消費者、小型企業和公司卡提供服務。 GMNS 部門參與經營全球支付網絡，該網絡處理和結算卡交易、收購商戶並提供多通路行銷計劃和功能、服務和數據分析。公司及其他部門涵蓋公司職能以及某些其他業務和營運。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、中東和非洲、亞太地區、拉丁美洲及加勒比地區和其他地區。 EMEA 部分代表歐洲、中東和非洲。亞太地區是指亞太地區、澳洲和紐西蘭。 LACC 部門專注於拉丁美洲、加拿大和加勒比地區。其他部門包括未直接分配給特定地理區域的淨成本。該公司由 Henry Wells、William G. Fargo 和 John Warren Butterfield 於 1850 年 3 月 28 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Blackstone, Inc. engages in the provision of investment and fund management services. It operates through the following segments: Real Estate, Private Equity, Credit and Insurance, and Hedge Fund Solutions. The Real Estate segment includes management of opportunistic real estate funds, Core+ real estate funds, high-yield real estate debt funds, and liquid real estate debt funds. The Private Equity segment consists of management of flagship corporate private equity funds, sector and geographically focused corporate private equity funds, core private equity funds, an opportunistic investment platform, a secondary fund of funds business, infrastructure-focused funds, a life sciences investment platform, a growth equity investment platform, a multi-asset investment program for eligible high net worth investors and a capital markets services business. The Credit and Insurance segment refers to Blackstone Credit, which is organized into two overarching strategies: private credit which includes mezzanine direct lending funds, private placement strategies, stressed and distressed strategies and energy strategies, and liquid credit which consists of CLOs, closed-ended funds, open ended funds and separately managed accounts. In addition, the segment includes an insurer-focused platform, an asset-based finance platform, and publicly traded master limited partnership investment platform. The Hedge Fund Solutions segment focuses on Blackstone Alternative Asset Management, which manages a broad range of commingled and customized hedge fund of fund solutions. It also includes a GP Stakes business and investment platforms that invest directly, as well as investment platforms that seed new hedge fund businesses and create alternative solutions through daily liquidity products. The company was founded by Stephen Allen Schwarzman in 1985 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Blackstone, Inc. 從事提供投資和基金管理服務。它透過以下部門運作：房地產、私募股權、信貸和保險以及對沖基金解決方案。房地產部門包括機會型房地產基金、Core+房地產基金、高收益房地產債務基金和流動性房地產債務基金的管理。私募股權部門包括旗艦企業私募股權基金、專注於行業和地理的企業私募股權基金、核心私募股權基金、機會主義投資平台、二級母基金業務、基礎設施重點基金、生命科學投資平台、成長型股權投資平台、面向合格高淨值投資者的多資產投資計劃以及資本市場服務業務的管理。信貸和保險部​​門指的是 Blackstone Credit，它分為兩個總體策略：私人信貸（包括夾層直接貸款基金、私募策略、壓力和不良策略和能源策略）以及流動性信貸（包括 CLO、封閉式基金、開放式基金和單獨管理帳戶）。此外，該部門還包括以保險公司為中心的平台、基於資產的融資平台和公開交易的主有限合夥投資平台。對沖基金解決方案部門專注於 Blackstone 另類資產管理，該公司管理各種混合和客製化的對沖基金解決方案。它還包括直接投資的 GP Stakes 業務和投資平台，以及培育新對沖基金業務並透過日常流動性產品創建替代解決方案的投資平台。該公司由史蒂芬艾倫施瓦茨曼 (Stephen Allen Schwarzman) 於 1985 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Dollar General Corp. engages in the operation of merchandise stores. Its offerings include food, snacks, health and beauty aids, cleaning supplies, basic apparel, housewares, and seasonal items. It sells brands including Clorox, Energizer, Procter & Gamble, Hanes, Coca-Cola, Mars, Unilever, Nestle, Kimberly-Clark, Kellogg's, General Mills, and PepsiCo. The company was founded by J. L. Turner and Hurley Calister Turner Sr. in 1939 and is headquartered in Goodlettsville, TN.
info.description_zh: Dollar General Corp. 從事商品店的經營。其產品包括食品、零食、健康和美容用品、清潔用品、基本服裝、家居用品和季節性商品。該公司銷售的品牌包括高樂氏 (Clorox)、勁量 (Energizer)、寶潔 (Procter & Gamble)、恆適 (Hanes)、可口可樂 (Coca-Cola)、瑪氏 (Mars)、聯合利華 (Unilever)、雀巢 (Nestle)、金佰利 (Kimberly-Clark)、Geneberly-Kers Mills、Geneberly-Kark Millss、Geneberly-Kers Millss、Geneberly-Kryce Mills） (PepsiCo)。該公司由 J. L. Turner 和 Hurley Calister Turner Sr. 於 1939 年創立，總部位於田納西州古德利茨維爾。

info.description: Jacobs Solutions, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the designing and deployment of technology-centric solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Infrastructure and Advanced Facilities, and PA Consulting. The Infrastructure and Advanced Facilities segment includes solutions for complex challenges related to energy security, environmental resilience, safe and reliable transportation, buildings and infrastructure, integrated water management and biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The PA Consulting segment includes the investment in PA Consulting Group. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Jacobs Solutions, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事以技術為中心的解決方案的設計和部署。它透過以下業務部門運作：基礎設施和先進設施以及 PA 諮詢。基礎設施和先進設施部門包括針對能源安全、環境彈性、安全可靠的交通、建築和基礎設施、綜合水管理和生物製藥製造等複雜挑戰的解決方案。 PA Consulting 部門包括對 PA Consulting Group 的投資。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial and investment banking services. The firm focuses on investment banking, financial services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial transaction processing, and asset management. It operates through the following segments: Consumer and Community Banking (CCB), Commercial and Investment Bank (CIB), Asset and Wealth Management (AWM), and Corporate. The CCB segment originates and services mortgage loans. The CIB segment makes markets and services clients across fixed income, foreign exchange, equities, and commodities. The AWM segment provides initial capital investments in products such as mutual funds and capital invested alongside third-party investors. The Corporate segment manages its liquidity, funding, capital, structural interest rate, and foreign exchange risks. The company was founded in 1799 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融和投資銀行服務。該公司專注於投資銀行、消費者和小型企業金融服務、商業銀行、金融交易處理和資產管理。它透過以下部門運作：消費者和社區銀行業務部門（CCB）、商業和投資銀行部門（CIB）、資產和財富管理部門（AWM）以及企業部門。 CCB 部門發放抵押貸款並提供服務。 CIB 部門在固定收益、外匯、股票和大宗商品領域開展市場並為客戶提供服務。 AWM 部門提供共同基金等產品的初始資本投資以及與第三方投資者一起投資的資本。企業部門管理其流動性、融資、資本、結構性利率和外匯風險。該公司成立於 1799 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Realty Income Corp. is a real estate company, which engages in generating dependable monthly cash dividends from a consistent and predictable level of cash flow from operations. The company was founded by William E. Clark, Jr. and Evelyn Joan Clark in 1969 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 零售
info.description_zh: Realty Income Corp. 是一家房地產公司，致力於透過持續且可預測的營運現金流水準產生可靠的每月現金股息。該公司由 William E. Clark, Jr. 和 Evelyn Joan Clark 於 1969 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Procter & Gamble Co. engages in the provision of branded consumer packaged goods. It operates through the following segments: Beauty, Grooming, Health Care, Fabric and Home Care, and Baby, Feminine and Family Care. The Beauty segment offers hair, skin, and personal care. The Grooming segment consists of shave care like female and male blades and razors, pre and post shave products, and appliances. The Health Care segment includes oral care products like toothbrushes, toothpaste, and personal health care such as gastrointestinal, rapid diagnostics, respiratory, and vitamins, minerals, and supplements. The Fabric and Home care segment consists of fabric enhancers, laundry additives and detergents, and air, dish, and surface care. The Baby, Feminine and Family Care segment sells baby wipes, diapers, and pants, adult incontinence, feminine care, paper towels, tissues, and toilet paper. The company was founded by William Procter and James Gamble in 1837 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: 寶潔公司 (Procter & Gamble Co.) 從事提供品牌消費品。該公司透過以下部門運作：美容、美容、保健、織物和家庭護理以及嬰兒、女性和家庭護理。美容部門提供頭髮、皮膚和個人護理。美容部門包括剃須護理產品，如女性和男性刀片和剃須刀、剃須前和剃須後產品以及器具。醫療保健部門包括牙刷、牙膏等口腔護理產品，以及胃腸、快速診斷、呼吸、維生素、礦物質和補充劑等個人保健產品。織物和家庭護理領域包括織物增強劑、洗衣添加劑和洗滌劑以及空氣、餐具和表面護理。嬰兒、女性和家庭護理部門銷售嬰兒濕紙巾、尿布和褲子、成人失禁、女性護理、紙巾、紙巾和衛生紙。該公司由 William Procter 和 James Gamble 於 1837 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: The Sherwin-Williams Co. engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of paint and coatings. It operates through the following segments: Paint Stores Group, Consumer Brands Group, Performance Coatings Group, and Administrative. The Paint Stores Group segment caters to the needs of architectural and industrial paint contractors and do-it-yourself homeowners. The Consumer Brands Group segment manufactures and distributes a broad portfolio of branded and private-label architectural paint, stains, varnishes and other industrial products. The Performance Coatings Group segment develops and sells industrial coatings for wood finishing and general industrial applications. The Administrative segment refers to the administrative expenses and assets of the company's new global headquarters and research and development center, both currently under construction. The company was founded by Henry Sherwin and Edward Williams in 1866 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: 宣偉公司從事油漆和塗料的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：油漆店集團、消費品牌集團、高性能塗料集團和行政部門。油漆店集團部門滿足建築和工業油漆承包商以及DIY房主的需求。消費品牌集團部門生產和分銷各種品牌和自有品牌建築塗料、著色劑、清漆和其他工業產品。高性能塗料集團部門開發和銷售用於木材塗飾和一般工業應用的工業塗料。行政部門是指公司目前正在興建的新全球總部和研發中心的行政費用和資產。該公司由 Henry Sherwin 和 Edward Williams 於 1866 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Welltower, Inc. is a health care infrastructure company, which engages in seniors housing operations, post-acute providers and health systems to fund the real estate infrastructure. The company's operating business segments include Seniors Housing Operating, Triple-Net, and Outpatient Medical. The Seniors Housing Operating segment operates properties including seniors apartments, independent living and independent supportive living, continuing care retirement communities, and assisted living, Alzheimer's dementia care and includes care homes with or without nursing. The Triple-Net segment properties offer services including independent living & supportive living (Canada), assisted living, continuing care retirement communities, Alzheimer's/dementia care and care homes with or without nursing (U.K.), and long-term/post-acute care. The Outpatient Medical segment invests in and operates outpatient medical buildings including physician offices, ambulatory surgery centers, diagnostic facilities, outpatient services and/or labs. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Toledo, OH.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 醫療保健設施
info.description_zh: Welltower, Inc. 是一家醫療保健基礎設施公司，從事老年人住房運營、急性期後醫療服務提供者和醫療系統，為房地產基礎設施提供資金。該公司的營運業務包括老年人住房運營、三網和門診醫療。老年人住房運營部門經營的物業包括老年人公寓、獨立生活和獨立支持性生活、持續護理退休社區、輔助生活、阿茲海默症癡呆護理，包括有或沒有護理的護理院。 Triple-Net 部門提供的服務包括獨立生活和支持性生活（加拿大）、輔助生活、持續照護退休社區、阿茲海默症/失智症照護和有或沒有照護的照護機構（英國）以及長期/急性期後照護。門診醫療部門投資並營運門診醫療建築，包括醫生辦公室、門診手術中心、診斷設施、門診服務和/或實驗室。該公司成立於 1970 年，總部位於俄亥俄州托萊多。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AAL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AAL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AAL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AAL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 AAL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 AAL 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. engages in the provision of power electronics conversion products. Its products include AC-DC power supply units, DC-DC conversion, high voltage amplifiers and power supplies, plasma power, controllers, sense, and measurement. The company was founded by Douglas S. Schatz in 1981 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. 從事提供電力電子轉換產品。其產品包括AC-DC電源裝置、DC-DC轉換、高壓放大器和電源、等離子電源、控制器、感測和測量。該公司由 Douglas S. Schatz 於 1981 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: Alumis, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, acquiring, and accelerating the development and commercialization of transformative medicines for autoimmune disorders. It focuses on building a pipeline of molecules with the potential to address a broad range of immune-mediated diseases such as monotherapy or combination therapies. The company was founded on January 29, 2021 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Alumis, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於識別、收購和加速自體免疫疾病轉化藥物的開發和商業化。它專注於建構一系列有潛力解決多種免疫介導疾病（例如單一療法或聯合療法）的分子。該公司成立於2021年1月29日，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Amkor Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services. Its services include design, package characterization, test, and wafer bumping services. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Amkor Technology, Inc. 從事提供外包半導體封裝和測試服務。其服務包括設計、封裝表徵、測試和晶圓凸點服務。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long AXP Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide a daily investment result, before fees and expenses, corresponding to twice the daily percentage change in the common stock of American Express Company. The fund utilizes a leveraged strategy to magnify the daily performance of its underlying security through a combination of direct investment and derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AXP 每日 ETF 是一種交易所交易基金，旨在提供扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於美國運通公司普通股每日百分比變化的兩倍。該基金利用槓桿策略，透過直接投資和衍生性商品的結合來放大其基礎證券的日常表現。

info.description: BOK Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Consumer Banking, Wealth Management, and Funds Management and Other. The Commercial Banking segment includes lending, treasury, and cash management services, as well as customer commodity risk management products for small businesses, middle market, and larger commercial customers. The Consumer Banking segment offers retail lending and deposit services, lending and deposit services to small business customers served through the retail branch network, and all mortgage banking activities. The Wealth Management segment provides fiduciary services, private bank services, and investment advisory services in all markets, as well as underwriting state and municipal securities. The Funds Management and Other segment manages overall liquidity needs and interest rate risks. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: BOK Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、消費銀行部門、財富管理部門、基金管理部門及其他部門。商業銀行部門包括貸款、資金和現金管理服務，以及為小型企業、中型市場和大型商業客戶提供的客戶商品風險管理產品。消費者銀行業務部門提供零售貸款和存款服務、透過零售分行網路向小型企業客戶提供貸款和存款服務以及所有抵押銀行業務。財富管理部門在所有市場提供信託服務、私人銀行服務和投資諮詢服務，以及承銷州和市政證券。資金管理及其他部門管理整體流動性需求和利率風險。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: Camtek Ltd. engages in the business of developing and manufacturing high-end inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. The firm is also involved in inspecting integrated circuits and measuring its features on wafers throughout the production process of semiconductor devices, covering the front and mid-end and up to the beginning of assembly. The company was founded on October 21, 1987 and is headquartered in Migdal HaEmek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Camtek Ltd.從事半導體行業高端檢測和計量設備的開發和製造業務。該公司還參與在整個半導體裝置生產過程中檢查積體電路並測量其在晶圓上的特徵，涵蓋前端和中端直至組裝開始。該公司成立於1987年10月21日，總部位於以色列Migdal HaEmek。

info.description: Cricut, Inc., distributes scrap book, craft and home decor items. The firm's products include its flagship line of cutting machines, such as the Cricut Maker family, the Cricut Explore family, and Cricut Joy, accompanied by other tools like Cricut EasyPress, the Infusible Ink system, and a diverse collection of materials. It operates through the following segments: Connected Machines, Subscriptions, and Accessories & Materials. The company was founded by Robert Workman in June 1969 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Cricut, Inc. 經銷剪貼簿、工藝品和家居裝飾品。該公司的產品包括其旗艦切割機系列，如 Cricut Maker 系列、Cricut Explore 系列和 Cricut Joy，以及 Cricut EasyPress、Infusible Ink 系統和各種材料等其他工具。它透過以下部門運作：互聯機器、訂閱以及配件和材料。該公司由 Robert Workman 於 1969 年 6 月創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: VictoryShares US Small Cap High Div Volatility Wtd ETF seeks to provide investment results that track the performance of the Nasdaq Victory US Small Cap High Dividend 100 Volatility Weighted Index. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets directly or indirectly in the securities included in the Nasdaq Victory US Small Cap High Dividend 100 Volatility Weighted Index, an unmanaged, volatility weighted index maintained exclusively by the index provider. The index identifies the 100 highest dividend yielding stocks in the Nasdaq Victory US Small Cap 500 Volatility Weighted Index.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares US Small Cap High Div Volatility Wtd ETF 尋求提供追蹤納斯達克勝利美國小盤高股息 100 波動加權指數表現的投資結果。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將其至少 80% 的資產直接或間接投資於納斯達克勝利美國小型股高股息 100 波動性加權指數（一種由指數提供商獨家維護的非託管波動性加權指數）所包含的證券來實現其投資目標。該指數確定了納斯達克勝利美國小型股 500 波動率加權指數中 100 隻股息殖利率最高的股票。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLI ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLI Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the industrial sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLI ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLI 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場工業部門公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Entegris, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of specialty materials for the microelectronics industry. It operates through the Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segments. The Materials Solutions segment provides materials-based solutions, such as chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition materials, chemical mechanical planarization ("CMP") slurries and pads, ion implantation specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials that enable customers to achieve better device performance and faster time to yield, while providing for lower total cost of ownership. The Advanced Purity Solutions segment offers filtration, purification and contamination-control solutions that improve customers' yield, device reliability and cost by ensuring the purity of critical liquid chemistries and gases and the cleanliness of wafers and other substrates used throughout semiconductor manufacturing processes, the semiconductor ecosystem and other high-technology industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Entegris, Inc. 從事微電子行業特殊材料的開發、製造和供應。它透過材料解決方案（MS）和高級純度解決方案（APS）部門運作。材料解決方案部門提供基於材料的解決方案，例如化學氣相和原子層沉積材料、化學機械平坦化（“CMP”）漿料和墊、離子注入特種氣體、配方蝕刻和清潔材料以及其他特種材料，使客戶能夠實現更好的裝置性能和更快的產量，同時降低總擁有成本。高階純度解決方案部門提供過濾、純化和污染控制解決方案，透過確保關鍵液體化學品和氣體的純度以及半導體製造流程、半導體生態系統和其他高科技產業中使用的晶圓和其他基材的清潔度，提高客戶的產量、設備可靠性和成本。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of banking and financial solutions. It offers commercial banking services, which serve the financial needs of the legal industry and small business communities, and commercial and retail customers in the New York metropolitan market. The company was founded by Dennis Shields in 2006 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.
info.description_zh: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. 從事提供銀行和金融解決方案。它提供商業銀行服務，滿足紐約大都會市場法律產業和小型企業界以及商業和零售客戶的金融需求。該公司由 Dennis Shields 於 2006 年創立，總部位於紐約州傑里科。

info.description: Franklin Electric Co., Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of water and fuel pumping systems. It operates through the following segments: Water Systems, Energy Systems, and Distribution. The Water Systems segment designs, manufactures, and sells water pumping systems, submersible motors, pumps, electronic controls, and related parts and equipment. The Energy Systems segment designs, manufactures and sells pumps, electronic controls and related parts and equipment primarily for use in submersible fueling system applications. The Distribution Segment offers pre-sale support and specifications to the installing contractors. The company was founded by Edward J. Schaefer and T. Wayne Kehoe in 1944 and is headquartered in Fort Wayne, IN.
info.description_zh: Franklin Electric Co., Inc. 從事水和燃油泵送系統的開發、製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：供水系統、能源系統和分銷部門。水系統部門設計、製造和銷售抽水系統、潛水馬達、泵浦、電子控制裝置以及相關零件和設備。能源系統部門設計、製造和銷售主要用於潛水加油系統應用的泵浦、電子控制裝置以及相關零件和設備。分銷部門為安裝承包商提供售前支援和規格。該公司由 Edward J. Schaefer 和 T. Wayne Kehoe 於 1944 年創立，總部位於印第安納州韋恩堡。

info.description: Full House Resorts, Inc. engages in the ownership, leasing, development, operation, and management of gaming, hospitality, and entertainment facilities. It operates through the following segments: Midwest & South, West, and Contracted Sports Wagering. The Midwest & South segment includes Silver Slipper, Rising Star and American Place. The West segment includes Chamonix, Bronco Billy's, Grand Lodge, and Stockman's. The Contracted Sports Wagering segment consists of on-site and online sports wagering skins in Colorado, Indiana and Illinois. The company was founded on January 5, 1987 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Full House Resorts, Inc. 從事博彩、飯店和娛樂設施的所有權、租賃、開發、營運和管理。它透過以下部門運作：中西部和南部、西部和合約體育博彩部門。中西部和南部部分包括 Silver Slipper、Rising Star 和 American Place。西區包括 Chamonix、Bronco Billy's、Grand Lodge 和 Stockman's。合約體育投注部分包括科羅拉多州、印第安納州和伊利諾伊州的現場和線上體育投注皮膚。該公司成立於1987年1月5日，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: First Trust SMID Capital Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the SMID Capital Strength Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by mid capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust SMID 資本強度 ETF 尋求與稱為 SMID 資本強度指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在選擇中等市值美國公司發行的派息證券。

info.description: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. owns and operates restaurants. It provides breakfast, brunch and lunch with alcohol and cocktails. The company was founded by John Sullivan in 1983 and is headquartered in Bradenton, FL.
info.description_zh: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. 擁有並經營餐廳。提供早餐、早午餐以及含酒精和雞尾酒的午餐。該公司由 John Sullivan 於 1983 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州布雷登頓。

info.description: Cambria Global EW ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or through other ETFs in publicly-traded stocks of companies located around the world. The fund will predominantly invest in securities of large capitalization companies, but may also include securities of mid- or small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Cambria Global EW ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過直接或透過其他 ETF 投資於世界各地公司的公開交易股票來實現其投資目標。該基金將主要投資於大型公司的證券，但也可能包括中型或小型公司的證券。

info.description: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of tires. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment is involved in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of tires and related products and services in North, Central, and South America. The Europe, Middle East, and Africa segment focuses on the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of tires for automobiles, trucks, buses, aircraft, motorcycles, earthmoving, mining, and industrial equipment throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The Asia Pacific segment refers to the development, manufacture, distribution, and sales of tires for automobiles, trucks, buses, aircraft, farm, earthmoving, mining, and industrial equipment throughout the Asia Pacific region. The company was founded by Frank A. Seiberling on August 29, 1898 and is headquartered in Akron, OH.
info.description_zh: 固特異輪胎橡膠有限公司從事輪胎的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。美洲部門在北美洲、中美洲和南美洲從事輪胎及相關產品和服務的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。歐洲、中東和非洲部門專注於歐洲、中東和非洲汽車、卡車、巴士、飛機、摩托車、土方、採礦和工業設備輪胎的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。亞太地區業務是指整個亞太地區汽車、卡車、巴士、飛機、農場、土方、採礦和工業設備輪胎的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。該公司由 Frank A. Seiberling 於 1898 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州阿克倫。

info.description: Healthcare Services Group, Inc. engages in the provision of healthcare management, administrative, and operating services. It operates through the following segments: Environmental Services (EVS) and Dietary. The EVS segment involves housekeeping, laundry, linen, and other services. The Dietary segment includes food purchasing, meal preparation, development of menus, and the provision of dietician consulting professional services. The company was founded by Daniel P. McCartney on November 22, 1976 and is headquartered in Bensalem, PA.
info.description_zh: Healthcare Services Group, Inc. 從事提供醫療保健管理、行政和營運服務。它透過以下部門運作：環境服務部門（EVS）和飲食部門。 EVS 部門涉及家政、洗衣、布草和其他服務。飲食部門包括食品採購、膳食準備、菜單開發以及提供營養師諮詢專業服務。該公司由 Daniel P. McCartney 於 1976 年 11 月 22 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州本薩勒姆。

info.description: Hudson Technologies, Inc. is a refrigerant services company, which engages in the provision of solutions to recurring problems within the refrigeration industry. Its products and services are primarily used in commercial air conditioning, industrial processing, refrigeration systems, refrigerant and industrial gas sales, and refrigerant management services. The company was founded by Stephen P. Mandracchia and Kevin J. Zugibe on January 11, 1991 and is headquartered in Woodcliff Lake, NJ.
info.description_zh: Hudson Technologies, Inc. 是一家冷媒服務公司，致力於為冷凍行業內反覆出現的問題提供解決方案。其產品和服務主要用於商用空調、工業加工、冷凍系統、冷媒和工業氣體銷售以及冷媒管理服務。該公司由 Stephen P. Mandracchia 和 Kevin J. Zugibe 於 1991 年 1 月 11 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Woodcliff Lake。

info.description: Hingham Institution for Savings provides community banking services. It is involved in the business of commercial and residential real estate mortgage lending, funded by retail deposits, wholesale deposits and borrowings. The company was founded in 1834 and is headquartered in Hingham, MA.
info.description_zh: 辛厄姆儲蓄機構提供社區銀行服務。它從事商業和住宅房地產抵押貸款業務，資金來源包括零售存款、批發存款和借款。該公司成立於 1834 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州欣厄姆。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2028 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2028 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. treasury bonds maturing in 2028. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2028 and December 15, 2028, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2028 Term Treasury ETF旨在追蹤由2028年到期的美國國債組成的ICE 2028 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2028 年 1 月 1 日至 2028 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: InterDigital, Inc. is a global research and development company, which engages in the business of wireless, video, artificial intelligence, and related technologies. It focuses on the design and development of communications, and entertainment products and services. The company was founded by Sherwin I. Seligsohn in 1972 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: InterDigital, Inc.是一家全球研發公司，從事無線、視訊、人工智慧及相關技術業務。它專注於通訊、娛樂產品和服務的設計和開發。該公司由 Sherwin I. Seligsohn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Value ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. In implementing its main strategies, it invests primarily in common stocks. The fund may also invest in real estate investment trusts (REITs).
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大價值 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。在實施其主要策略時，它主要投資於普通股。該基金也可以投資於房地產投資信託基金（REIT）。

info.description: Maase, Inc. engages in the provision of intelligent technology-driven family and enterprise services. It operates through the following business segments: Insurance Agency and Wealth Management. The Insurance Agency segment involves in providing agency services for distributing life and non-life insurance products on behalf of insurance companies. The Wealth Management segment offers financial advisory, investment planning, and asset management services for individuals, families, and corporate clients, utilizing data-driven insights and digital platforms to optimize financial outcomes. The company was founded by Hai Feng Yu on August 6, 2018, and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Maase, Inc. 致力於提供智慧科技驅動的家庭和企業服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：保險代理和財富管理。保險代理部門提供代表保險公司分銷人壽和非人壽保險產品的代理服務。財富管理部門為個人、家庭和企業客戶提供財務諮詢、投資規劃和資產管理服務，並利用數據驅動的見解和數位平台來優化財務成果。該公司由於海峰於2018年8月6日創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Xtrackers RREEF Global Natural Resources ETF seeks total return from both capital appreciation and current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes (calculated at the time of any investment), in securities of companies in the natural resources sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers RREEF 全球自然資源 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額（在任何投資時計算）投資於自然資源產業公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nova Ltd. provides metrology solutions for the semiconductor manufacturing industry. Its product portfolio includes dimensional metrology, modeling & software, materials metrology, and chemical metrology. The company was founded by Giora Dishon and Moshe Finarov in May 1993 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Nova Ltd. 為半導體製造業提供計量解決方案。其產品組合包括尺寸計量、建模和軟體、材料計量和化學計量。該公司由 Giora Dishon 和 Moshe Finarov 於 1993 年 5 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Next Technology Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of software development services to the customers and bitcoin acquisition. The company was founded on March 28, 2019 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: Next Technology Holding, Inc. 從事向客戶提供軟體開發服務和比特幣收購業務。公司成立於2019年3月28日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Polibeli Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in global goods trading, providing products procurement, and sales services to both upstream and downstream business partners. Its products include consumer electronic accessories, household appliances, skincare products, oral-care products, cosmetics products, toys and game products, health-care products, and watches and accessories. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
info.description_zh: Polibeli Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事全球貨物貿易，為上下游合作夥伴提供產品採購、銷售服務。其產品包括消費性電子配件、家用電器、保養品、口腔護理產品、化妝品、玩具和遊戲產品、保健產品以及手錶及配件。該公司成立於2024年3月12日，總部位於印尼雅加達。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600  Capped Materials Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. These companies are principally engaged in the business of producing raw materials, including producing and manufacturing chemical products; manufacturing construction materials, containers, and packaging; mining metals and the production of related products; and manufacturing paper and forest products. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Materials Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該等公司主要從事原料生產業務，包括生產及製造化學產品；製造建築材料、容器及包裝；開採金屬及相關產品的生產；以及造紙及林產品製造。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and provision of products and services for the renewable energy, residential, and infrastructure markets. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Infrastructure, and Agtech. The Residential segment includes roof and foundation ventilation products, rain dispersion products and roofing accessories, centralized mail systems, and electronic package solutions. The Infrastructure segment provides engineered solutions for bridges, highways, and airfields including structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, and bridge cable protection systems. The Agtech segment offers growing and processing solutions including designing, engineering, manufacturing, full scope construction, and maintenance and support of greenhouses, indoor growing operations, and botanical extraction systems. The company was founded on September 1, 1972 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. 從事為再生能源、住宅和基礎設施市場製造和提供產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、基礎設施部門和農業科技部門。住宅部門包括屋頂和地基通風產品、雨水分散產品和屋頂配件、集中式郵件系統和電子成套解決方案。基礎設施部門為橋樑、高速公路和機場提供工程解決方案，包括結構軸承、伸縮縫、路面密封、彈性混凝土和橋樑電纜保護系統。農業科技部門提供種植和加工解決方案，包括溫室、室內種植作業和植物提取系統的設計、工程、製造、全方位建設以及維護和支援。該公司成立於1972年9月1日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Roku, Inc. engages in the provision of a streaming platform for television. It operates through the following segments: Platform and Devices. The Platform segment includes the sale of digital advertising and distribution of streaming services. The Devices segment is involved in the sale of streaming players, Roku-made televisions, smart home products and services, audio products, and related accessories. The company was founded by Anthony J. Wood in October 2002 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Roku, Inc. 致力於提供電視串流平台。它透過以下部分運作：平台和設備。平台部門包括數位廣告的銷售和串流服務的分發。設備部門從事串流媒體播放器、Roku 製造的電視、智慧家居產品和服務、音訊產品以及相關配件的銷售。該公司由 Anthony J. Wood 於 2002 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Samfine Creation Holdings Group Ltd. operates as a holding company with interests in providing commercial printing services. Its operating subsidiaries offer printed products such as book products, which mainly include children's books, educational books, art books, notebooks, and diaries & journals. The firm also provides novelty and packaging products, which mainly include handcraft products, book sets, pop-up books, stationery products, and products with assembly parts. The company was founded on January 20, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Samfine Creation Holdings Group Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，致力於提供商業印刷服務。其營運子公司提供圖書產品等印刷產品，主要包括兒童圖書、教育圖書、藝術圖書、筆記本、日記本等。該公司還提供新奇和包裝產品，主要包括手工藝品、套裝書、立體書、文具產品和組裝零件的產品。該公司成立於2022年1月20日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Surgery Partners, Inc. is healthcare services holding company, which engages in the provision of solutions for surgical and related ancillary care in support of its patients and physicians. It operates through the following business segments: Surgical Facility Services, Ancillary Services, and Optical Services. The Surgical Facility Services segment consists of the operation of ambulatory surgery centers and surgical hospitals, including anesthesia services of the company. The Ancillary Services segment operates a diagnostic laboratory and multi-specialty physician practices. The Optical Services segment involves an optical laboratory and an optical products group purchasing organization. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Brentwood, TN.
info.description_zh: Surgery Partners, Inc. 是一家医疗保健服务控股公司，致力于提供手术和相关辅助护理解决方案，以支持患者和医生。它透過以下業務部門運作：手術設施服務、輔助服務和光學服務。手術設施服務部門包括門診手術中心和外科醫院的運營，包括公司的麻醉服務。輔助服務部門經營診斷實驗室和多專業醫師診所。光學服務部門包括光學實驗室和光學產品集團採購組織。該公司成立於 2004 年，總部位於田納西州布倫特伍德。

info.description: Operates as a holding company, which provides property, casualty and life insurance services
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: 作為控股公司運營，提供財產、傷亡和人壽保險服務

info.description: VSE Corp. is focused on significantly enhancing the productivity and longevity of its customers' high-value, business-critical assets. It operates through the Aviation and Fleet segments. The Aviation segment is a provider of aftermarket parts distribution and MRO services for components and engine accessories supporting commercial, business and general aviation operators. The Fleet segment focuses on the parts distribution, engineering solutions, and mission critical supply chain management services supporting the medium and heavy-duty fleet market. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: VSE Corp. 致力於大幅提升客戶高價值、業務關鍵型資產的生產力與壽命。它透過航空和機隊部門運作。航空部門是為商業、公務和通用航空業者提供零件和引擎配件的售後零件分銷和 MRO 服務提供者。車隊部門專注於支援中型和重型車隊市場的零件分銷、工程解決方案和關鍵任務供應鏈管理服務。該公司成立於 1959 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。

info.description: Winmark Corp. engages in operating a franchise retail store which includes children's and women's apparel, sporting goods, and musical instruments. The firm's franchise brands include Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore, and Music Go Round. It operates through the Franchising and Other segments. The Franchising segment is involved in value-oriented retail store concepts that buy, sell, trade, and consign merchandise, and provides strategic consulting services related to franchising. The Other segment includes the middle-market equipment leasing and small-ticket franchising businesses conducted through Winmark Capital Corp. and Wirth Business Credit, Inc. The company was founded on July 20, 1988 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Winmark Corp. 從事特許經營零售店的經營，其中包括兒童和女性服裝、體育用品和樂器。該公司的特許經營品牌包括 Plato's Closet、Once Upon A Child、Play It Again Sports、Style Encore 和 Music Go Round。它透過特許經營和其他部門運作。特許經營部門涉及以價值為導向的零售商店概念，購買、銷售、交易和寄售商品，並提供與特許經營相關的策略諮詢服務。其他部門包括透過 Winmark Capital Corp. 和 Wirth Business Credit, Inc. 進行的中階市場設備租賃和小額特許經營業務。該公司成立於 1988 年 7 月 20 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: US Treasury 2 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 2-Year US Treasury Index. Under normal market conditions, the Adviser seeks to achieve the investment objective by investing at least 80% of net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the index. The index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 2-year US Treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 2 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE BofA 當前 2 年期美國國債指數的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數的組成證券來實現投資目標。該指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 2 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: US Treasury 3 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index (GA03). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 3-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 3 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 3 年期美國國債指數 (GA03) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美银美林当前 3 年期美国国债指数是一种单一证券指数，由最近发行的 3 年期美国国债组成。

info.description: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called The International Developed Capital Strength Index SM. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and REITs that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to well-capitalized companies in the developed markets outside of the U.S. with strong market positions that have the potential to provide their stockholders with a greater degree of stability and performance over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「國際開發資本強度指數 SM」的指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在為美國以外已開發市場中資本充足、市場地位穩固的公司提供投資機會，這些公司有可能隨著時間的推移為其股東提供更大程度的穩定性和績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: Direxion Daily AAPL Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AAPL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to AAPL equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AAPL Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 AAPL 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具組合起來為 AAPL 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿風險敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的至少 80%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on August 8, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Infinite Eagle Acquisition Corp.是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月8日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Direxion Daily NVDA Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X inverse (opposite) or short leveraged exposure to NVDA equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily NVDA Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 NVDA 每日表現相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 1 倍反向（相反）或空頭槓桿敞口，相當於基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的至少 80%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Parker-Hannifin Corp. engages in the manufacture of motion and control technologies and systems. It operates through the Diversified Industrial and Aerospace Systems segments. The Diversified Industrial segment sells products to both original equipment manufacturers and distributors who serve the replacement markets in manufacturing, packaging, processing, transportation, mobile construction, refrigeration and air conditioning, agricultural and military machinery, and equipment industries. The Aerospace Systems segment offers products primarily in the commercial and military aerospace markets to both OEMs and to end users for spares, maintenance, repair, and overhaul. The company was founded by Arthur L. Parker in 1918 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: Parker-Hannifin Corp. 從事運動和控制技術及系統的製造。它透過多元化工業和航空航天系統部門運作。多元化工業部門向原始設備製造商和分銷商銷售產品，這些製造商和分銷商服務於製造、包裝、加工、運輸、移動建築、製冷和空調、農業和軍用機械以及設備行業的替代市場。航空航太系統部門主要在商業和軍用航空航太市場向原始設備製造商和最終用戶提供備件、維護、修理和大修產品。該公司由 Arthur L. Parker 於 1918 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Erie Indemnity Co. engages in the insurance business and operates as an attorney-in-fact. It manages affairs at the Erie Insurance Exchange for the benefit of the policyholders. It covers policies in auto and leisure, home and property, life, and business insurance. The company was founded by Henry Orth Hirt and Ollie Grover Crawford on April 4, 1925, and is headquartered in Erie, PA.
info.description_zh: 伊利賠償公司 (Erie Indemnity Co.) 從事保險業務，並作為事實上的律師開展業務。它為保單持有人的利益管理伊利保險交易所的事務。它涵蓋汽車和休閒、家庭和財產、人壽和商業保險的保單。該公司由 Henry Orth Hirt 和 Ollie Grover Crawford 於 1925 年 4 月 4 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伊利。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2028 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2028 (collectively, "2028 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2028 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2028 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2028 年債券」）。

info.description: Indigo Acquisition Corp. is blank check company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase and reorganization. Its objective is to identify and acquire an established, profitable company with strong fundamentals and significant upside potential. The company was founded on June 07, 2024 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Indigo Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，旨在進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。其目標是識別並收購一家基礎雄厚且具有巨大上升潛力的成熟、盈利的公司。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 7 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Brighthouse Financial, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of life insurance and annuities through independent distribution channels and marketing arrangements with a diverse network of distribution partners. It operates through the following segments: Annuities, Life, Run-Off, and Corporate & Others. The Annuities segment product offerings include fixed, structured, income and variable annuities. The Life segment manufactures products to serve its target segments through a broad independent distribution network. The Run-Off segment includes structured settlements, pension risk transfer contracts, certain company-owned life insurance policies, funding agreements and universal life with secondary guarantees. The Corporate & Other segment refers to the general account investments and the separate account assets of the company. The company was founded in June 1863 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Brighthouse Financial, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，透過獨立的分銷管道以及與多元化分銷合作夥伴網絡的營銷安排提供人壽保險和年金。它透過以下部門運作：年金部門、人壽部門、徑流部門以及企業及其他部門。年金部門提供的產品包括固定年金、結構性年金、收入年金及可變年金。生活部門生產產品，透過廣泛的獨立分銷網絡服務於其目標部門。 Run-Off 部分包括結構性結算、退休金風險轉移合約、某些公司擁有的人壽保險保單、融資協議和帶有二級擔保的萬能人壽保險。公司及其他部門是指公司的一般帳戶投資和獨立帳戶資產。該公司成立於 1863 年 6 月，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. engages in the operation of a general consumer product retail and wholesale business selling to customers through various channels including retail locations, websites, catalogs, and mobile applications. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Subscription, and Wholesale. The Retail segment includes store and digital channels including Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands. The Subscription segment consists of the Nuuly brand, which is a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service. The Wholesale segment focuses on sale through department and specialty stores worldwide. The company was founded by Richard A. Hayne and Scott A. Belair in 1970 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Urban Outfitters, Inc. 從事一般消費品零售和批發業務，透過零售地點、網站、目錄和行動應用程式等多種管道向客戶銷售產品。它透過以下部門運作：零售、訂閱和批發。零售部門包括商店和數位管道，包括 Anthropologie、Free People、FP Movement 和 Urban Outfitters 品牌。訂閱部門由 Nuuly 品牌組成，該品牌提供每月女裝訂閱租賃服務。批發部門專注於透過全球百貨公司和專賣店進行銷售。該公司由 Richard A. Hayne 和 Scott A. Belair 於 1970 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Edison International is a renewable energy company, which through its subsidiaries, generates and distributes electric power, and invests in energy services and technologies. The company was founded on July 4, 1886, and is headquartered in Rosemead, CA.

info.description_zh: 愛迪生國際是一家再生能源公司，透過其子公司生產和分配電力，並投資能源服務和技術。該公司成立於 1886 年 7 月 4 日，總部位於加利福尼亞州羅斯米德。

info.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of household, personal care, and specialty products. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division (SPD). The Consumer Domestic segment offers household products, such as laundry detergents, fabric softener sheets, cat litter, household cleaning products, and personal care products including antiperspirants, oral care products, depilatories, reproductive health products, oral analgesics, nasal saline moisturizers, and dietary supplements. The Consumer International segment is involved in the personal care, household and over-the-counter products in international subsidiary markets, including Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, China, and the United Kingdom. The SPD segment consists of sales to businesses and participates in three product areas: animal nutrition, specialty chemicals, commercial, and professional. The company was founded by Dwight John and Austin Church in 1846 and is headquartered in Ewing, NJ.
info.description_zh: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. 从事家居、个人护理和特色产品的开发、制造和营销。它通过以下部门运营：国内消费者部门、国际消费者部门和特种产品部门 (SPD)。國內消費品部門提供家用產品，如洗衣粉、織物柔軟劑片、貓砂、家庭清潔產品和個人護理產品，包括止汗劑、口腔護理產品、除毛劑、生殖健康產品、口腔鎮痛劑、鼻鹽水保濕劑和膳食補充劑。國際消費品部門涉足國際附屬市場的個人護理、家庭和非處方產品，包括澳洲、加拿大、法國、德國、日本、墨西哥、中國和英國。 SPD 部门包括对企业的销售，并参与三个产品领域：动物营养、特种化学品、商业和专业。该公司由 Dwight John 和 Austin Church 于 1846 年创立，总部位于新泽西州尤因。

info.description: VanEck Pharmaceutical ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Pharmaceutical 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the pharmaceutical industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Pharmaceutical ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製 MVIS 美國上市製藥 25 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數包括美國交易所上市的製藥業公司的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Quest Diagnostics, Inc. engages in the provision of diagnostic testing, information, and services. It operates through the Diagnostic Information Services (DIS) and All Other segments. The DIS segment offers diagnostic information services to physicians, hospitals, patients, and consumers. The All Other segment consists of risk assessment services and healthcare information technology. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Secaucus, NJ.
info.description_zh: Quest Diagnostics, Inc. 從事提供診斷測試、資訊和服務。它透過診斷資訊服務（DIS）和所有其他部門運作。 DIS 部門為醫生、醫院、病患和消費者提供診斷資訊服務。所有其他部門包括風險評估服務和醫療保健資訊科技。該公司成立於 1967 年，總部位於新澤西州錫考克斯。

info.description: McKesson Corp. engages in providing healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology and Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions (RxTS), and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The North American Pharmaceutical segment focuses on distribution of branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs to customers in U.S. and Canada. The Oncology and Multispecialty segment includes provision of solutions that includes specialty drug distribution, group purchasing organizations, infusion services, direct to patient pharmacy capabilities, InspiroGene cell and gene therapy services, technology solutions, practice consulting services, and vaccine distribution. The RxTS segment focuses on solving medication access, affordability, and adherence challenges for patients by working across healthcare to connect patients, pharmacies, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, and biopharma companies. The Medical-Surgical Solutions segment provides medical-surgical supply distribution, logistics, and other services to healthcare providers. The company was founded by John McKesson and Charles Olcott in 1833 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: McKesson Corp. 從事提供醫療保健服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：北美製藥部門、腫瘤學和多專科部門、處方技術解決方案（RxTS）部門和醫療外科解決方案部門。北美製藥部門專注於向美國和加拿大的客戶分銷品牌藥品、仿製藥、特殊藥品、生物相似藥和非處方藥品。腫瘤學和多專科部門提供的解決方案包括特殊藥物分銷、團體採購組織、輸液服務、直接面向患者的藥房能力、InspiroGene 細胞和基因治療服務、技術解決方案、實踐諮詢服務和疫苗分銷。 RxTS 部門專注於透過跨醫療保健領域連接患者、藥房、提供者、藥品福利管理者、健康計劃和生物製藥公司，解決患者的藥物取得、負擔能力和依從性挑戰。醫療外科解決方案部門為醫療保健提供者提供醫療外科用品分銷、物流和其他服務。該公司由 John McKesson 和 Charles Olcott 於 1833 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of treatments for dermatological diseases. Its pipeline consists of topical treatments for plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hand eczema, vitiligo, scalp psoriasis, alopecia areata, and seborrheic dermatitis. The company was founded by Bhaskar Chaudhuri and David W. Osborne in June 2016 and is headquartered in Westlake Village, CA.
info.description_zh: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. 從事皮膚病治療的開發和商業化。其產品線包括斑塊型乾癬、異位性皮膚炎、手部濕疹、白斑症、頭皮乾癬、斑禿和脂漏性皮膚炎的局部治療。該公司由 Bhaskar Chaudhuri 和 David W. Osborne 於 2016 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州西湖村。

info.description: Ingles Markets, Inc. engages in the operation of a supermarket chain in Georgia, North Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and Alabama. It offers its products through the following categories: grocery, non-foods, perishables and other. The grocery products consist of groceries, dairy, and frozen foods. The non-foods products include alcoholic beverages, tobacco, pharmacy, health, beauty, and cosmetic products. The perishable products include meat, produce, deli, and bakery. The other category consists of fluid dairy operations and shopping center rentals. The company was founded by Robert P. Ingle in 1963 and is headquartered in Black Mountain, NC.
info.description_zh: Ingles Markets, Inc. 在喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、田納西州、維吉尼亞州和阿拉巴馬州從事連鎖超市的經營。它提供以下類別的產品：雜貨、非食品、易腐爛食品等。雜貨產品包括雜貨、乳製品和冷凍食品。非食品產品包括酒精飲料、菸草、藥品、保健、美容和化妝品。易腐爛的產品包括肉類、農產品、熟食店和麵包店。另一類包括流體乳製品業務和購物中心租賃。該公司由 Robert P. Ingle 於 1963 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州黑山。

info.description: Invesco Water Resources ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ OMX US Water IndexSM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to track the performance of companies that create products designed to conserve and purify water for homes, businesses and industries. The underlying index may include common stocks, ordinary shares, American depositary receipts ("ADRs"), shares of beneficial interest and tracking stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Water Resources ETF 旨在追蹤 NASDAQ OMX US Water IndexSM（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤那些為家庭、企業和工業生產節約和淨化用水的產品的公司的表現。標的指數可能包括普通股、普通股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、受益股和追蹤股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of orthopedic reconstructive products. The firm also offers sports medicine, biologics, extremities, and trauma products, spine, craniomaxillofacial, and thoracic products, office-based technologies, dental implants, and related surgical products. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment consists of the U.S. and includes other North, Central and South American markets. The Europe Middle East and Africa segment includes France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom. The Asia Pacific segment refers to the key markets such as Japan, China, Australia, New Zealand, Korea, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. The company was founded by Justin O. Zimmer in 1927 and is headquartered in Warsaw, IN.
info.description_zh: Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. 從事骨科重建產品的設計、製造和行銷。該公司還提供運動醫學、生物製品、四肢和創傷產品、脊椎、顱顏面和胸部產品、辦公室技術、牙科植體和相關外科產品。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。美洲部分包括美國以及其他北美、中美和南美市場。歐洲、中東和非洲部分包括法國、德國、義大利、西班牙和英國。亞太地區是指日本、中國、澳洲、紐西蘭、韓國、台灣、印度、泰國、新加坡、香港和馬來西亞等主要市場。該公司由 Justin O. Zimmer 於 1927 年創立，總部位於印第安納州華沙。

info.description: Timberland Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It offers mortgage loans, consumer loans, and commercial business loans. The company was founded on September 8, 1997 and is headquartered in Hoquiam, WA.
info.description_zh: Timberland Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它提供抵押貸款、消費貸款和商業貸款。該公司成立於1997年9月8日，總部位於華盛頓州霍奎姆。

info.description: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. provides outpatient mental health services. It offers patients a suite of mental health services, including psychiatric evaluations and treatment, psychological, and neuropsychological testing, as well as individual, family, and group therapy. The firm operates outpatient mental health platform as well as offers patients care virtually through its online delivery platform or in-person at its centers in 32 states. The company was founded by Michael K. Lester, Gwen H. Booth and Danish J. Qureshi in 2017 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. 提供門診心理健康服務。它為患者提供一套心理健康服務，包括精神病學評估和治療、心理和神經心理學測試以及個人、家庭和團體治療。該公司經營門診心理健康平台，並透過其線上交付平台或在 32 個州的中心親自為患者提供虛擬護理。該公司由 Michael K. Lester、Gwen H. Booth 和Danish J. Qureshi 於 2017 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: C&F Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services to individuals and businesses. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking, Mortgage Banking and Consumer Finance. The Community Banking segment provides checking and savings deposit accounts, business, real estate, development, mortgage, home equity, and installment loans. The Mortgage Banking segment offers ancillary mortgage loan origination services for loan settlement and residential appraisals. The Consumer Finance segment consists of automobile financing through lending programs that are designed to serve customers in the non-prime market who have limited access to traditional automobile financing. The company was founded on March 8, 1994 and is headquartered in Toano, VA.
info.description_zh: C&F Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於向個人和企業提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行業務、抵押銀行業務和消費金融業務。社區銀行業務部門提供支票和儲蓄存款帳戶、商業、房地產、開發、抵押貸款、房屋淨值和分期貸款。抵押貸款銀行部門為貸款結算和住宅評估提供輔助抵押貸款發放服務。消費金融部門透過貸款計畫提供汽車融資，旨在為傳統汽車融資管道有限的非主要市場客戶提供服務。該公司成立於1994年3月8日，總部位於維吉尼亞州托阿諾。

info.description: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for the treatment of solid tumors and other major diseases. Its product, Certepetide, is designed to activate a novel uptake pathway that allows co-administered or tethered anti-cancer drugs to target and penetrate tumors. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Basking Ridge, NJ.
info.description_zh: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療實體瘤和其他重大疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化。其產品 Certepetide 旨在激活一種新型攝取途徑，使聯合給藥或聯合抗癌藥物能夠靶向並滲透腫瘤。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於新澤西州巴斯金里奇。

info.description: Merit Medical Systems, Inc. engages in the manufacture and marketing of proprietary disposable medical devices. It operates through the Cardiovascular and Endoscopy segments. The Cardiovascular segment consists of peripheral intervention, cardiac intervention, interventional oncology and spine, and cardiovascular and critical care product groups. The Endoscopy segment integrates non-vascular stent technology with balloon dilators, inflation devices, guide wires, procedure kits, and other devices that are used by gastroenterologists, endoscopists, pulmonologists, and thoracic and general surgeons. The company was founded by Fred P. Lampropoulos, Darla Gill, Kent W. Stanger, and William Padilla in July 1987 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Merit Medical Systems, Inc. 從事專有一次性醫療設備的製造和行銷。它透過心血管和內視鏡部分運作。心血管部門包括週邊介入、心臟介入、介入腫瘤和脊椎、心血管和重症監護產品組。內視鏡領域將非血管支架技術與球囊擴張器、充氣裝置、導引線、手術套件以及胃腸病學家、內視鏡醫師、肺病學家、胸腔外科和一般外科醫師使用的其他設備結合。該公司由 Fred P. Lampropoulos、Darla Gill、Kent W. Stanger 和 William Padilla 於 1987 年 7 月創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: Lockheed Martin Corp. is a global security and aerospace company, which engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of technology systems, products, and services. It operates through the following business segments: Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control (MFC), Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), and Space. The Aeronautics segment researches, designs, develops, manufactures, integrates, sustains, supports, and upgrades advanced military aircraft, including combat and air mobility aircraft, unmanned air vehicles, and related technologies. The MFC segment is involved in air and missile defense systems, tactical missiles and air-to-ground precision strike weapon systems, logistics, fire control systems, mission operations support, readiness, engineering support and integration services, manned and unmanned ground vehicles, and energy management solutions. The RMS segment designs, manufactures, services, and supports various military and commercial helicopters, surface ships, sea and land-based missile defense systems, radar systems, sea and air-based mission and combat systems, command and control mission solutions, cyber solutions, and simulation and training solutions. The Space segment includes the production of satellites, space transportation systems, and strategic, advanced strike, and defensive systems. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 洛克希德馬丁公司是一家全球安全和航空航太公司，從事技術系統、產品和服務的研究、設計、開發、製造、整合和維護。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：航空、飛彈和火控（MFC）、旋轉和任務系統（RMS）以及航太。航空部門研究、設計、開發、製造、整合、維護、支援和升級先進軍用飛機，包括戰鬥和空中機動飛機、無人機和相關技術。 MFC部門涉及防空和飛彈防禦系統、戰術飛彈和空對地精確打擊武器系統、後勤、火控系統、任務行動支援、戰備、工程支援和整合服務、有人和無人地面車輛以及能源管理解決方案。 RMS部門設計、製造、服務和支援各種軍用和商用直升機、水面艦艇、海基和陸基飛彈防禦系統、雷達系統、海基和空基任務和作戰系統、指揮和控制任務解決方案、網路解決方案以及模擬和訓練解決方案。太空部門包括衛星、太空運輸系統以及戰略、先進打擊和防禦系統的生產。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Latham Group, Inc. operates as a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of in-ground residential swimming pools in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. It offers a portfolio of pools and related products, including in-ground swimming pools, pool liners, and pool covers. The company was founded on December 6, 2018 and is headquartered in Latham, NY.
info.description_zh: Latham Group, Inc. 在北美、澳洲和紐西蘭從事地下住宅游泳池的設計、製造和行銷。它提供一系列泳池及相關產品，包括地下游泳池、泳池襯墊和泳池蓋。該公司成立於2018年12月6日，總部位於紐約州萊瑟姆。

info.description: The Clorox Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of consumer and professional products. It operates through the following business segments: Health and Wellness, Household, Lifestyle, and International. The Health and Wellness segment consists of cleaning products, professional products and vitamins, minerals and supplements mainly marketed and sold in the United States. The Household segments consists of bags and wraps, grilling products and cat litter marketed and sold in the United States. The Lifestyle segment refers to food, natural personal care products and water-filtration products marketed and sold in the United States. The International segment covers products sold outside the United States, excluding natural personal care products. The company was founded by Edward Hughes, Charles Husband, William Hussey, Rufus Myers, and Archibald Taft on May 3, 1913 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Clorox Co. 從事消費品和專業產品的製造和行銷。它透過以下業務部門運作：健康與保健、家庭、生活方式和國際。健康與保健部門包括主要在美國行銷和銷售的清潔產品、專業產品以及維生素、礦物質和補充劑。家用部門包括在美國行銷和銷售的袋子和包裝、燒烤產品和貓砂。生活風格部門是指在美國行銷和銷售的食品、天然個人護理產品和水過濾產品。國際部門涵蓋在美國境外銷售的產品，不包括天然個人護理產品。該公司由 Edward Hughes、Charles Husband、William Hussey、Rufus Myers 和 Archibald Taft 於 1913 年 5 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Sanofi engages in the research, production, and distribution of pharmaceutical products. It operates through the Biopharma segment, which comprises commercial operations and research, development and production activities relating to the specialty care, general medicines and vaccines franchises plus support and corporate functions, for all geographical territories. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: 賽諾菲從事醫藥產品的研究、生產和分銷。該公司透過生物製藥部門運營，該部門包括與所有地理區域的專業護理、普通藥物和疫苗特許經營權以及支持和公司職能相關的商業運營以及研究、開發和生產活動。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of containment and delivery systems for injectable drugs and healthcare products. It operates through the Proprietary Products and Contract-Manufactured Products segments. The Proprietary Products segment offers proprietary packaging, containment solutions, drug delivery systems, analytical lab services, and other integrated services and solutions, primarily to biologic, generic, and pharmaceutical drug customers. The Contract-Manufactured Products segment serves as a fully integrated business focused on the design, manufacture, and automated assembly of complex devices, primarily for pharmaceutical, diagnostic, and medical device customers. The company was founded by Herman O. West on July 27, 1923 and is headquartered in Exton, PA.
info.description_zh: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. 從事注射藥物和醫療保健產品的密封和輸送系統的設計、製造和銷售。它透過專有產品和合約製造產品部門運作。專有產品部門主要向生物藥品、仿製藥和製藥藥品客戶提供專有包裝、密封解決方案、給藥系統、分析實驗室服務以及其他綜合服務和解決方案。合約製造產品部門是一個完全整合的業務，專注於複雜設備的設計、製造和自動化組裝，主要針對製藥、診斷和醫療設備客戶。該公司由 Herman O. West 於 1923 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州埃克斯頓。

info.description: Nutex Health, Inc. engages in the management and operation of healthcare facilities. It operates through the following segments: Hospital Division, Population Health Management Division, and Real State Division. The Hospital Division is involved in developing and operating a network of micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments (HOPDs). The Population Health Division establishes and operates provider networks such as independent physician associations (IPAs). The Real State Division owns land and hospital buildings which are leased to hospital entities. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nutex Health, Inc. 從事醫療保健設施的管理和營運。它透過以下部門運作：醫院部門、人口健康管理部門和房地產部門。醫院部門參與開發和營運微型醫院、專科醫院和醫院門診部 (HOPD) 網路。人口健康部門建立並運作獨立醫師協會 (IPA) 等提供者網路。房地產部門擁有出租給醫院實體的土地和醫院建築。該公司成立於 2011 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Token Cat Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the operation of an omni-channel automotive marketplace. It offers auto shows, group-purchase facilitation, and virtual dealership services. The company was founded by Wei Wen and Jian Chen Sun in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Token Cat Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事全通路汽車市場的運營。它提供車展、團購便利性和虛擬經銷商服務。該公司由Wei Wen和Jian Chen Sun於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Sotera Health Co. provides mission-critical sterilization, lab testing and advisory services to the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. It also provides end-to-end sterilization as well as microbiological and analytical lab testing and advisory services to help ensure that medical, pharmaceutical and food products are safe for healthcare practitioners, patients and consumers. The firm operates through the following businesses: Sterigenics, Nordion, and Nelson Labs. The Sterigenics business provides outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and advanced applications markets by using following technologies: gamma irradiation, EO processing and E-beam irradiation. The Nordion business provides Co-60 and gamma irradiators, which are the key components to the gamma sterilization process. The Nelson Labs business provides outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Broadview Heights, OH.
info.description_zh: Sotera Health Co. 為醫療器材和製藥業提供關鍵任務滅菌、實驗室測試和諮詢服務。它還提供端到端滅菌以及微生物和分析實驗室測試和諮詢服務，以幫助確保醫療、藥品和食品對醫療保健從業者、患者和消費者來說是安全的。該公司透過以下業務運營：Sterigenics、Nordion 和 Nelson Labs。 Sterigenics 業務透過使用以下技術為醫療器材、製藥、食品安全和先進應用市場提供外包終端滅菌和輻照服務：伽馬輻照、EO 處理和電子束輻照。 Nordion 業務提供 Co-60 和伽馬輻照器，它們是伽馬滅菌過程的關鍵組件。尼爾森實驗室業務為醫療器材和製藥業提供外包微生物和分析化學測試和諮詢服務。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於俄亥俄州布羅德維尤高地。

info.description: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in developing, manufacturing, marketing, and selling technically challenging generic and proprietary injectable, inhalation, and intranasal products, and insulin active pharmaceutical ingredient. It operates through Finished Pharmaceutical Products and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Products segments. The Finished Pharmaceutical Products segment manufactures, markets, and distributes Primatene Mist, enoxaparin, naloxone, phytonadione, lidocaine, and other critical and non-critical care drugs. The Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Products segment offers RHI API and porcine insulin API for external customers and internal product development. The company was founded by Zi-Ping Luo and Yong Feng Zhang on February 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Rancho Cucamonga, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 從事開發、製造、行銷和銷售技術上具有挑戰性的仿製藥和專利注射劑、吸入劑和鼻內產品以及胰島素活性藥物成分。它透過成品藥品和活性藥物成分產品部門運作。藥品成品部門生產、行銷和分銷 Primatene Mist、依諾肝素、納洛酮、植物萘二酮、利多卡因以及其他重症和非重症護理藥物。活性藥物成分產品部門為外部客戶和內部產品開發提供 RHI API 和豬胰島素 API。該公司由羅子平和張永峰於1996年2月29日創立，總部位於加州庫卡蒙加牧場。

info.description: Waste Management, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of waste management environmental services. It operates through the following segments: Collection and Disposal-East Tier (East Tier), Collection and Disposal-West Tier (West Tier), Recycling Processing and Sales, Renewable Energy, and Healthcare Solutions. The East Tier segment includes the Eastern United States, the Great Lakes Region, and Canada. The West Tier segment refers to the upper Midwest region and British Columbia, Canada. The Recycling Processing and Sales segment focuses on the processing and sales of materials collected from residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Renewable Energy segment develops, operates, and promotes projects for landfill gas use. The Healthcare Solutions segment relates to its primarily business to business company providing services that protect people and brands, promote health and well-being and safeguard the environment. The company was founded on September 30, 1987 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Waste Management, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供廢棄物管理環境服務。它透過以下部門運作：收集和處置-東層（East Tier）、收集和處置-西層（West Tier）、回收加工和銷售、再生能源和醫療保健解決方案。東線部分包括美國東部、五大湖地區和加拿大。西部線段是指中西部上游地區和加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省。回收加工和銷售部門專注於從住宅、商業和工業客戶收集的材料的加工和銷售。再生能源部門開發、營運和推廣垃圾掩埋氣利用計畫。醫療保健解決方案部門主要涉及企業對企業公司，提供保護人員和品牌、促進健康和福祉以及保護環境的服務。該公司成立於1987年9月30日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: CrossingBridge Pre-Merger SPAC ETF seeks to provide total returns consistent with the preservation of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that under normal market conditions will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in shares of common stock and units of Special Purpose Acquisitions Companies ("SPACs") that have yet to consummate a shareholder-approved merger or business combination. The fund seeks to invest in publicly-traded SPACs that at the time of purchase are trading at or below the SPAC's pro rata trust account value. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: CrossingBridge Pre-Merger SPAC ETF 尋求提供與資本保值一致的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常市場條件下，將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於尚未完成股東批准的合併或業務合併的普通股和特殊目的收購公司（「SPAC」）的單位。該基金尋求投資於公開交易的 SPAC，這些 SPAC 在購買時的交易價格等於或低於 SPAC 按比例的信託帳戶價值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vericel Corp. engages in the research, product development, manufacture, and distribution of patient-specific, expanded cellular therapies for use in the treatment of patients with diseases. Its product portfolio includes MACI and Epicel. The MACI portfolio is FDA-approved product that applies the process of tissue engineering to grow cells on scaffolds using healthy cartilage tissue from the patient's own knee. The Epicel portfolio provide skin replacement for patients who have deep dermal or full thickness burns. The company was founded on March 24, 1989 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Vericel Corp. 從事患者特異性擴展細胞療法的研究、產品開發、製造和分銷，用於治療疾病患者。其產品組合包括 MACI 和 Epicel。 MACI 產品組合是 FDA 批准的產品，它應用組織工程流程，利用患者自己膝蓋的健康軟骨組織在支架上培養細胞。 Epicel 產品組合為深度真皮或全層燒傷的患者提供皮膚替代品。該公司成立於1989年3月24日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: AXS 1.25X NVDA Bear Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to one and a quarter times the inverse (-125%) of the daily performance of the common shares of NVIDIA Corporation. Under normal market circumstances, the adviser will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide one and a quarter times inverse leveraged exposure to the daily performance of NVDA. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve on a daily basis, before fees and expenses, -125% performance of NVDA for a single day, not for any other period, by entering into one or more swap agreements on NVDA. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 1.25X NVDA Bear Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果，相當於 NVIDIA 公司普通股每日業績倒數的一又四分之一倍 (-125%)。在正常市場情況下，顧問將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為 NVDA 的日常業績提供一又四分之一倍的反向槓桿敞口。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過在 NVDA 上簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，在每日基礎上（未計費用和開支）實現 NVDA 單日業績的 -125%，而不是在任何其他時期。它是非多元化的。

info.description: AXS Short Innovation Daily ETF seeks to provide investment results that are approximately the inverse of, before fees and expenses, to the daily price and yield performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund is an actively managed ETF that the advisor attempts to achieve the inverse (-1x) of the return of the ARK Innovation ETF for a single day by entering into a swap agreement on the ARK Innovation ETF. The ARK Innovation ETF is an actively managed ETF that seeks long-term growth of capital by investing primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of companies that are relevant to the fund's investment theme of disruptive innovation. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS Short Innovation Daily ETF 力求提供與 ARK Innovation ETF 的每日價格和收益率表現大致相反的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，顧問試圖透過簽訂 ARK Innovation ETF 掉期協議來實現 ARK Innovation ETF 單日回報的倒數（-1 倍）。 ARK Innovation ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，透過主要投資於與該基金顛覆性創新投資主題相關的公司的國內外股票證券來尋求資本的長期增長。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc. is a late-stage specialty pharmaceutical company focused on the global development and commercialization of cytisinicline as a treatment of nicotine dependence. Its products include cytisine, a plant-based alkaloid with a binding affinity to the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor. The company was founded in October 1991 and is headquartered in Bothell, WA.
info.description_zh: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc.是一家後期專業製藥公司，專注於治療尼古丁依賴的金雀花鹼的全球開發和商業化。其產品包括金雀花鹼，一種與菸鹼乙醯膽鹼受體具有結合親和力的植物生物鹼。該公司成立於 1991 年 10 月，總部位於華盛頓州博塞爾。

info.description: Fortive Corp. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and marketing of professional and engineered products, software, and services for a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Intelligent Operating Solutions, Precision Technologies, and Advanced Healthcare Solutions. The Intelligent Operating Solutions segment provides solutions to accelerate industrial and facility reliability and performance, as well as compliance and safety across a range of vertical end markets, including manufacturing, process industries, healthcare, utilities and power, communications, and electronics. The Precision Technologies segment supplies technologies such as electrical test and measurement instruments and services, energetic material devices, and a broad portfolio of sensor and control system solutions.
